definitions.explanation: A padded bag designed for sleeping in, typically used for camping, hiking, or emergency situations. Provides insulation and protection from the elements.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寝袋|ねぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っていく→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I bring a sleeping bag when camping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧{寝袋|ねぶくろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: Even on cold nights, a sleeping bag keeps you warm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寝袋|ねぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}しておいた→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
examples.english: I prepared a sleeping bag for disaster preparedness.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (sleep) + ⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧ (bag). The second element voices to {袋|ぶくろ} in the compound, a regular sound change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝袋|ねぶくろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to get into a sleeping bag
- {寝袋|ねぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to spread out a sleeping bag
- {寝袋|ねぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畳|たた}む→畳む：02073_tatamu⟧: to fold one up
- ⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧{寝袋|ねぶくろ}: a rectangular ('envelope-shaped') bag
- マミー⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧{寝袋|ねぶくろ}: a mummy-shaped bag, tapered at the feet

ALSO CALLED:
シュラフ, from German Schlafsack, is common among experienced campers and in outdoor-shop catalogues. {寝袋|ねぶくろ} is the plain everyday word and is what a non-camper will say.
